title: [Dev] AAPSClient Pump status display 0% and red color color when using Dash
symptom: When using Dash, the AAPSClient pump status displays 0% and red color, whereas on master this issue is not present. Expected to see 'x min ago Closed Loop' in normal colors.
cause: The root cause is not fully identified, but the issue is related to Dash reporting battery as 0 or invalid, causing the pump status to show 0% and red color.
fix: A change in NSDeviceStatusHandler.kt ignores battery percent values of 0 or invalid, and a commit (0bfd8305736f48bd13b49169faeff4c38cb82660) was made to fix the issue.
evidence_quote: This change in NSDeviceStatusHandler.kt fixes the issue for me, but not sure if it's a proper fix. I'm not able to at first glance locate the root cause to why Dash is reporting battery.
